{{Quote|So how was my funeral?''"<br />"''A better performance than you, your corpse gave.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda|<ref name="Deception" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a mock '''funeral''' was held for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] after his faked [[Death/Legends|death]] by [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. The [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] was attended by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] as well as [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Obi-Wan's "body" was clothed and lowered into a lower coffin chamber, and then sealed with a laser device. During the services, Tano expressed her concern about Skywalker's mood and lack of speech to Plo Koon since Kenobi's faked death. Satine Kryze could also be heard crying during the service.<ref name="Deception" />

The purpose of this deception was for Obi-Wan to be able to go undercover as the bounty hunter [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] while everyone believed him dead, so that he could uncover a plot to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine. Most of the Jedi Council knew about the plan, but Anakin was kept in the dark.<ref name="Deception" />
